name: CUSTODIAN — Crèche of Answerless Names | High-Fidelity PBR Layered Art

authority.note: Existing Asset V2 family JSON files, not this proposed schema, determine published runtime state contracts.
authority.publication_note: Published as a design-only source manifest; not an Asset V2 registration, approved source-art receipt, runtime cutover, or an update to the 198-state global roadmap.

visual_lock.target: high-fidelity realistic 3D MODELLED / PBR SURFACE RENDERED into layered 2D Godot scenes, NOT painted pixel-art tiles, isometric game board or flat schematic
visual_lock.engine: Godot existing Node2D / Sprite2D layout. No 3D gameplay scene migration authorized.
visual_lock.projection: orthographic renderer perpendicular to floor / camera 90-degree overhead, north up; real 3D model geometry and relief visible through realistic surface/light/height, but no perspective skew or fake isometric rotation
visual_lock.pixel_registration: 1 source-composition pixel = 1 authored Godot world unit at normalized display scale, 32px architectural construction rhythm; 32px is NOT a hard visible checker grid
visual_lock.quality: PBR modeled limestone, weathered basalt, aged brass, iron and utilitarian ceramic; beveled physical edges, scanned stone microsurface, layered roughness, plausible wear and restrained local AO
visual_lock.palette: desaturated chalk limestone, charcoal basalt, blackened iron; aged bronze/brass for authority, cold dim teal ONLY on real operational consoles

rendering.method: Blender/Cycles or equivalent offline high-fidelity 3D renderer
rendering.working_color_space: linear scene-referred rendering; convert final PNG to sRGB without corrupting alpha
rendering.sample_target: visually noise-free / denoised without smearing features; no hard sample number as proof
rendering.source_master_rule: For each frame render 4x horizontal and vertical pixel resolution. Downsample the approved source in linear light to exact existing family/frame canvas; frame-to-frame anchor remains identical.
rendering.camera_lock: one orthographic capture transform and scale shared by floor/shell/fixtures, with deliberate per-prop pivot registration

notes: Preserve normal physical relief, cast localized occlusion on own geometry, but do not bake room-wide directional cast shadows on floor-only material.
False depth/parallax or side-view elevation not allowed unless compositor and occlusion registration are tested.
Avoid making a 960x704 opaque solid rectangle that covers void outside the floor. Floor material may be opaque; room-registered floor plate uses alpha outside exposed floor.

phases: P0 freeze scene snapshot and extract current 960x704 room and 128px Operator composition; inspect actual art source bytes, including alpha; preserve old runtime until cutover.
P1 generate/review PBR 512x512 stone material and floor-only 960x704 composited underlay with transparent outside exposed floor and unchanged origin.
P2 generate/review L1 insets (floor seal, aisle, north threshold) independently as true RGBA.
P3 generate/review L2 structural shell and north exit frame, with exact occlusion and existing eight inactive alcove sockets.
P4 compare fixtures/recovery/console with new 3D-rendered style; selectively reauthor only failed states; measure screen-local FX anchor.
P5 review all candidate images at native resolution, actual 2.25x camera setting, 128px Operator context, no hidden underlay machine; obtain per-image human source approvals.
P6 register new Asset V2 families and required-assets registry, stage immutable source masters, normalize/ingest through the existing tools; atomically bind reviewed layers; keep one visible console.
P7 run focused Godot layout/route/interactible/FX/alpha/occlusion and source receipt tests, verify both entry/exit and live 8f screen event; update current-state documentation.

objective: All 16 existing required family/state IDs and frame contracts remain unchanged until their independently approved cutover.
Six new REQUIRED art-state proposals explicitly unregistered; four additional proposed optional; existing registered optional states remain optional.
L0 stone_base 512x512 RGB; normalized underlay 960x704 with real transparency outside floor, not a solid border or invented walls.
No baked console, alcove bodies, relic table or architecture in floor plates; no overlapping duplicate actor/prop artwork.
All assets with transparent specification have measurable true RGBA with zero-matte transparency; printed checkerboard is not alpha.
Record per-image SHA256, frame count, pixel size, alpha bounds and source/normalized hashes; test independent sprites and composite.
Preserve one real Crèche Console at (112,144), visible body (105,118), existing action/readout, wake at (0,160).
128px wide north passage stays unobstructed; scene remains 2D with unchanged collision and camera policy.
No prompt for inactive scenic objects or the wake pod; screen FX stays attached to actual console body.
Keep existing perimeter owner, all headwall fixture family IDs and 8f event timings, no duplicate light/shadow silhouette.
Floor base 3x3 tile visual test without obvious repetition and exact opposing edge pixel continuity; visually inspect after rendering.
Run native scale Operator and camera captures; human PBR aesthetic approval before runtime promotion.
validation.pass_condition: Separate actual rendering, compositing, native-scale tests, source approval, Asset V2 ingestion and gameplay integration evidence. Manifest alone does not establish readiness.

roadmap_alignment.program_scope: This Crèche decomposed sub-manifest does not silently increment or fulfill the 198/193 global art inventory. Reconcile IDs and shared existing perimeter sets before global queue migration.
roadmap_alignment.registered_state_policy: Do not rename/supersede old family IDs by adding near-duplicate states under the same name; the existing underlay remains the compatibility composition target.
